description: vault-orch hooks. The Stop hook promotes a finished /make or /build session's prompt.md `## Metadata` block into variant-B frontmatter (jira wikilinks) on its session files, keeping the Obsidian vault current with zero forking of the agent-orch skills. It is fully defensive: it no-ops outside an agent-orch repo, when the vault is not initialised, or when no session is found, and it never blocks or fails the session.
